concerns.text: Task T002 states it will attempt to download UK Biobank data and, if unavailable, fall back to an open dataset or raise a RuntimeError. This allows the pipeline to proceed with only a single cohort, thereby weakening FR-001 which mandates downloading *both* AGP and UKBB datasets.

Task T011 runs DESeq2 on raw count data, explicitly violating VI. Compositional Data Analysis Compliance of the constitution, which requires all downstream analyses to use CLR‑transformed data (FR-003).

Task T006 describes computing Spearman correlations and bootstrap SE but does not mention applying Benjamini‑Hochberg FDR correction, contrary to FR-005 and SC-003 which require q‑values to be reported.
Task T007 runs MaAsLin2 and outputs beta coefficients and p‑values, yet it also omits any step applying BH FDR correction, again breaching FR-005/SC-003.
Task T012 flags replication per taxon but does not compute or report the overall cross‑cohort replication rate percentage required by SC-006.
Task T003 harmonises and filters the cohorts but includes no verification that the unified dataset contains at least 1,000 samples, as mandated by SC-007.

The plan’s summary (see plan.md) explicitly notes that UK Biobank is not publicly downloadable and substitutes a fallback dataset, directly contradicting FR-001’s requirement for UKBB data and constituting an undocumented scope reduction.
